messages:
Maya (CSM): Kicking off Firgrove Health onboarding. Goal: staging integration + pilot with 30 clinicians in 28 days. Need owners for infra, metrics, enablement, and compliance. Flag blockers please.

Diego (Success Ops): Success metrics to track: DAU >= 12 in pilot, error rate < 2%, and median latency < 250ms. Renewal risk if DAU < 8 at 45 days. Recommend in-app 1-click feedback and a weekly pulse.

Priya (Solutions Eng): I can own infra/integration. Need a sanitized sample dataset and a staging API key. Planning: smoke test day 2, e2e day 6. Do we want streaming for summaries?

Hannah (Product): Start non-streaming for predictability. We'll add streaming in week 2 if needed. I'll define 3 acceptance flows: intake summary, triage suggestion, and search by symptoms.

Evan (Enablement): I'll run two sessions: dev walkthrough (25m) and clinical ops (30m). Dev on day 3, clinical on day 8. I'll produce a one-pager and 6 example prompt templates.

Maya (CSM): Proposed owners: infra = Priya, metrics = Diego, enablement = Evan, product sign-off = Hannah. I'll add to the onboarding board and set weekly 30-min syncs.

Diego (Success Ops): Risk capture: concentration of usage in <3 users = red. I'll set dashboard thresholds and a renewal watchlist. Also request a short list of failure cases from Firgrove.

Priya (Solutions Eng): For sharing with customer, example curl: ```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer STG_FIRG_XXXX" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"input":"summarize: intake note"}' https://staging-api.redwood.ai/v1/generate```
Please create STG_FIRG_XXXX and share via secure channel.

KeyBot: staging-key: STG_FIRG_XXXX provisioned and posted to firgrove-secure. Logs retention default 90 days (sanitization flag ON).

Evan (Enablement): Quick question: do we want annotated examples of expected outputs for training? If so, can Firgrove provide 10 anonymized examples?

Maya (CSM): Yes please — I'll request 10 anonymized examples and 5 failure modes from the customer.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Action items: 1) Priya: smoke test D2, e2e D6; 2) Diego: dashboards + pulse by D5; 3) Evan: materials + sessions scheduled; 4) Hannah: acceptance flows posted. Ack with ETAs.

Priya (Solutions Eng): Ack  smoke test tomorrow (1789087000), e2e by day 6 (1789437000).

Diego (Success Ops): Ack  dashboard + pulse by day 5.

Evan (Enablement): Ack  cheat sheet draft by day 3, sessions on calendar.

Hannah (Product): Ack  flows posted to board.

Maya (CSM): Great work. Closing kickoff thread; will post board link shortly and open weekly sync invite. Drop blockers here. :raised_hands:
